attr.title: RPG2LX - RPG Maker MV HUB
attr.desc: HUB for RPG Maker MV games with a native engine (QuickJS + SDL2) that runs the original corescripts and plugins unmodified, as an exported game, with full Canvas 2D, DOM and Node/NW.js API support. Per-game button mapping to MV actions or keys.
attr.inst: Copy each complete RPG Maker MV game (export or project folder) into its own folder inside ports/rpg2lx/games/. Saves (.rpgsave) and settings are kept outside game assets.
